implement_intro: Everything you need to build a home guard, an agent integration or a validator – and to show that it conforms.
implement_model_body: A mandate belongs to one agent and holds rules. Each rule names resources (a device, a category or an area), actions and a decision. Rule order never matters: of all matching rules, the strictest decision wins.
implement_model_optional: ? marks an optional field. Generated from the JSON Schema of the mandate.
implement_classes_intro: An implementation conforms to one or more classes. It conforms to a class of a version if it passes all cases of that class.
implement_class_evaluator_body: Validates mandates, computes their digests and evaluates requests (sections 3 and 4).
implement_class_selection_body: Selects the mandate to evaluate among several stored ones (section 4.3).
implement_class_signatures_body: Verifies signed mandates and the succession of mandate versions (sections 3.5 and 7).
implement_class_audit_body: Verifies the hash chain of audit logs and computes entry digests (section 9.4).
implement_class_audit_anchored_body: Additionally verifies the signed checkpoints of a log (section 9.5).
implement_class_pdp_body: Answers AuthZEN requests from its own mandate store and resource directory (sections 4.3 and 6).
implement_class_pdp_cases: valid evaluator and selection cases, over HTTP
implement_classes_note: Evaluator is the basis: anything that claims to evaluate mandates conforms to it. The obligations of the guard (section 11) cannot be tested from outside yet; an implementation states how it meets them.
implement_install_body: The test tool mandate-conformance contains the cases of its version and plays them against your implementation, whatever its language: through a small harness that reads and writes one JSON line per request, or over HTTP for a PDP. Its report names the version, the classes and the manifest.
implement_install_more: [Section 10 of the spec](/spec/v0/) describes both ways.
implement_dl_note: Verify files with the SHA-256 checksum.
implement_dl_mandate_body: JSON Schema of a mandate and its rules.
implement_dl_vocabulary_body: {count} device categories, their actions and which actions are critical.
implement_dl_audit_body: JSON Schema of an audit log entry.
implement_list_intro: Projects that implement mandate-spec. A conformance class counts as passed only when the test run is published; otherwise it is what the project declares.
implement_list_empty: No entries of this kind yet.
implement_list_note: The list is kept in the [site repository](https://github.com/mandate-spec/mandate-spec.org/blob/main/src/lib/content/implementations.ts). Add your project with a pull request; link a published conformance run to have its classes shown as passed.
